texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 8 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The two brand colors and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, backgrounds and surfaces including any tint or gradient, overlays on photos, online / active, like, error / disabled), plus type scale, spacing, radii, blur and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the tab bar, the tabs, the sheet, the drawer and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the photos, logo and icons from 04 · Media. Each person always uses their own portrait. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 8 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The two brand colors and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, backgrounds and surfaces including any tint or gradient, overlays on photos, online / active, like, error / disabled), plus type scale, spacing, radii, blur and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the tab bar, the tabs, the sheet, the drawer and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the photos, logo and icons from 04 · Media. Each person always uses their own portrait.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
